sections.title: Earth Zoom Out
sections.subtitle: Pull back from street level to orbit

preset.title: Earth Zoom Out
preset.summary: The camera starts at street level and pulls straight up until the whole region is in frame

items.title: Neon Glow
items.summary: Turns the scene to night and lights the edges with soft neon, with a slow push-in

items.title: Dolly Zoom
items.summary: The camera moves back while zooming in, so the subject stays put and the background stretches

items.title: Slow-mo Hair
items.summary: A slow, close move with hair and fabric drifting in the wind

items.title: Disintegration
items.summary: The subject breaks into dust that drifts out of frame

items.title: Anime Shift
items.summary: Redraws the photo as hand-drawn animation, with a gentle pan

items.title: Crash Zoom
items.summary: A fast zoom into the subject's face

items.title: 360 Orbit
items.summary: The camera circles the subject once at eye level

items.title: FPV Drone
items.summary: A drone dives toward the subject and flies past it

items.title: Handheld
items.summary: Subtle handheld shake, like a phone held by a friend
